key_highlights: ASX slides as rising oil prices fuel rate hike bets; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall on margin compression fears
RBA deputy governor signals inflation remains too high, reinforcing hawkish bias and rate hike expectations
Iron ore in sustained downtrend ('drowning, not waving'); BHP under existential pressure as commodity crumbles
Hormuz Strait escalation and Germany gas shortage risk spike energy prices, pressuring global equities
Gold sector active: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Aureka snaps up Victorian mine for $8.9M
Property sector faces 'GFC moment' domestically; NZ house price crash returns, amplifying REIT/property risk
Qantas (QAN.AX) $35M redundancy payout and jet incident weigh on airline sentiment
Santos (STO.AX) gas cartel exposure intensifies as domestic gas pricing under scrutiny
Living standards collapse narrative: mortgage costs driving second jobs, public sector boom masking private-sector weakness
ATO escalates tax enforcement against Big Tech, signalling broader compliance risk for listed entities

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP facing severe earnings pressure. Gold miners active with multiple ASX-listed producers (Forrestania, Kaiser, Aureka, Larvotto) expanding output or acquiring assets. Uranium exploration (Infini) adds diversification.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face continued downside as iron ore 'crumbles'. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NZG.AX, FOR.AX, KAL.AX, AUK.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows and Trump-related uncertainty. Diversify away from iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rate hike bets compress net interest margins and raise credit-loss concerns. Property 'GFC moment' and NZ crash elevate NPL risk. ATO tax enforcement adds compliance cost.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. Rate hikes support NIM short-term but property stress and living standards collapse threaten loan book quality. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Rising oil prices and Hormuz Strait escalation support upstream. Santos gas cartel scrutiny creates regulatory overhang. Germany gas shortage risk lifts LNG pricing.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, XVG.AX benefit from oil spike. STO.AX faces regulatory/political risk from gas cartel narrative. LNG exporters (GAS.AX, WDS.AX) supported by European demand.

sectors.trend: Property industry faces 'GFC moment'; NZ house price crash returns. Mortgage costs driving household stress. Construction capacity deficit ('lost ability to build').
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) and property developers (WBC.AX exposure, CGP.AX) face valuation pressure. Housing supply crunch is structural but demand is weakening.

sectors.trend: Qantas $35M payout and jet incident damage QAN.AX sentiment. Supply crunch jacking up car insurance premiums. Living standards collapse pressures discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX under pressure. Insurance names (WBC.AX, CGA.AX) face premium inflation. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) relatively defensive but face margin pressure.

sectors.trend: Medical institute fund misappropriation allegation creates sector overhang. AI disruption narrative (Goldman Sachs warning) pressures tech valuations. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight adds regulatory risk.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (health) face reputational risk from institute scandal. Tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face AI-disruption overhang. Monitor CSL closely.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: inflation persistence driving rate hike bets, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors
Iron ore structural decline: BHP/RIO/FMG earnings at risk; pivot to gold and uranium
Geopolitical energy risk: Hormuz Strait, Germany gas shortage lifting oil/LNG
Property stress cycle: NZ crash, domestic GFC fears, mortgage affordability crisis
Living standards collapse: second jobs, public sector dependency, private consumption weakening
Gold sector consolidation: multiple ASX miners expanding, safe-haven demand elevated
Regulatory enforcement: ATO tax crackdown, gas cartel scrutiny, medical fund misappropriation

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property developers); favour fixed-income ladders; hedge with short AUD/USD
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX, NZG.AX) and uranium (NCV.AX, INL.AX)
Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, XVG.AX; monitor AUD/USD as oil spike pressures terms of trade
Reduce REIT exposure (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX); monitor bank NPL data; favour cash-rich balance sheets
Avoid STO.AX near-term; monitor ACCC proceedings; favour diversified energy (WDS.AX, GSR.AX)
Favour defensive staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX); reduce discretionary consumer exposure; monitor retail sales data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and supply-side consolidation
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser Tassie expansion, Aureka $8.9M acquisition signal sector consolidation; gold supported by Trump uncertainty and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add LNG / upstream energy on oil spike and European gas shortage
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz escalation and Germany storage lag support oil/LNG pricing; WDS and XVG benefit from higher realisation

opportunities.recommendation: Uranium exploration exposure on supply tightness
opportunities.rationale: Infini 7.5% uranium discovery in Canada signals global supply gap; ASX uranium names benefit

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downtrend; BHP earnings at risk; 'suicide' narrative signals severe sentiment deterioration

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim REIT and property developer positions
defensive_moves.rationale: Property 'GFC moment', NZ crash, mortgage stress elevate credit and valuation risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk via short AUD/USD and long bond duration
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish bias and oil-driven inflation risk push rates higher, pressuring equities and AUD

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid STO.AX pending gas cartel resolution
defensive_moves.rationale: Regulatory and political overhang from cartel allegations; reputational and litigation risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) under pressure from rate hike bets, iron ore weakness, and geopolitical oil risk. Banks and property lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative strength. Expect 3–5% index volatility over next 4–6 weeks. AUD/USD likely under pressure from oil-driven inflation and RBA hawkishness.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift away from iron ore toward gold, uranium, and LNG. Property sector faces multi-year adjustment. Living standards collapse constrains consumer recovery. RBA likely to hold or hike, keeping financials under margin pressure. Gold and energy remain structural beneficiaries. ASX 200 likely range-bound with sector rotation dominating.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and inflation data (CPI)
Iron ore price trajectory (China demand, supply additions)
Hormuz Strait / Middle East geopolitical escalation
US midterms impact on global risk appetite
Property credit data and NPL trends
watch_list: RBA cash rate and deputy governor commentary
Iron ore spot price (62% Fe) and BHP/RIO guidance
Brent crude and TTF gas prices
CPI, retail sales, housing credit data
Gold price (XAU/USD) and ASX gold miner sentiment
